## General Documentation for wrapper package 

This documentation provides a comprehensive overview of the `wrapper` package, outlining its purpose, functionalities, and usage guidelines. The `wrapper` package simplifies project setup and dependency management by providing a standardized configuration mechanism and automating common tasks. It aims to streamline development workflows and ensure consistency across projects.  The package includes a Maven wrapper configuration file (`maven-wrapper.properties`) that automatically downloads and executes the correct version of Apache Maven for a project, eliminating the need for manual Maven installation on developers' systems. This configuration simplifies project setup and ensures consistent Maven versions across different environments.
